definitions.short: a set time ; technically, a year
definitions.full: H5732. iddan עִדָּן noun masculine Dan 2:9 time ( ᵑ7 id. , Syriac , perhaps loan-word from Assyrian adannu , fixed , appointed , or definite, time ; [Arabic probably Aramaic loan-word, Schw ZMG liii (1899), 197 ]); — absolute ׳ע 7:12 +; emphatic עִדָּנָא 2:8 +; plural absolute עִדָּנִין 4:13 +, emphatic עִדָּנַיָּא 2:21 ; — 1 in General, time , as duration Dan 2:8 ; 7:12 ; involving specific conditions 2:9 , 21 ; (point of) time 3:5 , 15 . 2 definite time , = year (as modern Greek χρόνος , see EASophocles 1173 ): ע ׳שִׁבְעָה = seven years , Dan 4:13 ; 4:20 ; 4:22 ; 4:29 ; עִדָּן וּפְלַג וְעִדָּנִין עִדָּן 7:25 (i.e. 3 2-Janyears, see Dr; perhaps read dual for plural, compare Bev Gunk Schöpf. 201 ).
